description: Use this when the person you are helping has an upcoming appointment (primary care, diabetes, kidney, rheumatology, eye, oncology, cardiology, podiatry or pharmacist) for type 2 diabetes, kidney disease, lupus or a cancer history and wants to be ready. Job "visit_prep" returns, in one reply: the routine checks to raise with THAT clinician (each with its guideline source), checks that belong with other doctors, the questions to ask, what to bring, and a one-page printable visit sheet. It needs NO lab values, dates, names or records: only the condition, a few medicine classes, which clinician, and for each routine test whether it was done recently (recent / overdue / never / unsure). The reply includes a job_ref: keep it, and get_job_result returns the same sheet later (for example the day before the visit, or in a new conversation). Every result ends with next_steps. Free. Nothing is stored. Decision support, not a diagnosis.

conditions.description: The long-term condition(s) the person has. One or more of: type2_diabetes, kidney_disease, lupus, cancer_survivorship.

job.description: The job to hand over. Today: visit_prep.

medications.description: Medicine classes the person takes, if relevant. Allowed: metformin, insulin, sulfonylurea, ace_inhibitor_or_arb, hydroxychloroquine, glucocorticoids.

test_status.description: For each routine test you know about: recent, overdue, never, or unsure. Omit tests you do not know. Test ids: a1c, uacr, egfr_creatinine, lipid_panel, dilated_eye_exam, foot_exam, vitamin_b12, liver_fibrosis_screen, cbc, electrolytes_potassium, bone_mineral_labs, urinalysis_urine_protein, lupus_activity_labs, hcq_retinal_screen, blood_pressure_check, vaccines_review, cardiac_function_test, thyroid_tsh, bone_density_scan, survivorship_follow_up, age_appropriate_cancer_screens, distress_screen.

treatment_exposures.description: For cancer survivorship only: past treatment types. Allowed: anthracycline_or_trastuzumab, chest_radiation, neck_radiation, aromatase_inhibitor_or_androgen_deprivation, immune_checkpoint_inhibitor.

visit_with.description: Who the appointment is with. One of: primary_care, diabetes_clinician, kidney_clinician, rheumatologist, eye_doctor, oncologist, cardiologist, podiatrist, pharmacist.

name: start_job

job_ref.description: Keep this. get_job_result(job_ref) returns the same result later, in any conversation.

next_steps.description: What to offer the person next, in order.

checks_for_this_visit.description: Routine checks to raise with this clinician, most important first.

other_open_checks.description: Open checks that belong with other doctors.

printable_visit_sheet_markdown.description: One-page visit sheet the person can print or paste.

title: Hand Phi a whole job: get the person ready for a doctor's appointment (no lab values or records needed)
